entries: your own drink is off-limits. Every sip comes from someone else's, with their blessing
you drink with your pinky out
you hold eye contact with someone through every sip
you sell every sip like it's the best decision you've made all night
every sip gets a sound effect
you drink like someone's about to cut you off
you can't set your drink down
you drink facing away from the group
you drink with your eyes closed
you narrate the flavor like a sommelier who's clearly never done this before
you hold the glass above your eye line for the entire sip
